status: author-confirmed matrix used for the released figure analysis
preparation_history: The local numerical matrix was initially reconstructed by matching cell colors in the existing Figure 5 image to its colorbar.
Corresponding off-diagonal entries were averaged to create a symmetric matrix; diagonal entries were set to one.
The author subsequently confirmed that these symmetric values match the intended Figure 5 matrix and that the independently calculated metrics round to 0.479, 0.296, and 0.027.
domain_labels: The predefined domain categories shown in Figure 5; no clustering algorithm was fitted to choose these labels.
verification_scope: The evaluation script recomputes metrics from the supplied matrix. This is not a reproduction of model training or a direct checkpoint export.
numeric_precision_note: CSV precision preserves the prepared numerical artifact; it does not establish the precision of unavailable original model arrays.
